title: Integrate by parts twice
text: Let $$u=sin(x)$$ and $$dv=e^x dx$$. Then use integration by parts a second time with $$u=cos(x)$$ and $$dv=e^x dx$$.

title: Solve for the integral
text: Calling the original integral I, the two rounds give $$I=e^x sin\left(x\right)-e^x cos\left(x\right)-I$$. Solve this equation for I.
